item.title: GPT-6 Astra · 输入 $10 / 输出 $50 / 缓存读取 $1（每百万 tokens）
item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。输入 $10 / 输出 $50 / 缓存读取 $1（每百万 tokens）。Standard · 短上下文。展示 Standard 短上下文价；长上下文每百万 tokens：输入 $20、输出 $75、缓存读取 $2、写入 $25。Batch / Flex 为 Standard 的 50%，Fast 为 2 倍；适用地域处理端点加价 10%，工具另计。 Astra Ultrafast 为对应 Standard 的 6 倍；短上下文输入 $60、输出 $300、缓存读取 $6、写入 $75。 核验日期：2026-11-21。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. Standard · short context. Standard short-context rates. Long context per million tokens: input $20, output $75, cache reads $2, writes $25. Batch / Flex costs 50% of Standard and Fast costs 2×. Eligible regional-processing endpoints add 10%; tools bill separately. Astra Ultrafast costs 6× the applicable Standard rate: short-context input $60, output $300, cache reads $6 and writes $75.

item.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash · 输入 $0.75 / 输出 $3.75 / 缓存读取 $0.075（每百万 tokens）
item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。输入 $0.75 / 输出 $3.75 / 缓存读取 $0.075（每百万 tokens）。Standard · 2026 年内活动价。历史活动价为输入 $0.75、输出 $3.75、缓存读取 $0.075 / 百万 tokens；输出含思考 tokens，缓存存储与搜索另计。官方弃用表确认该模型已不再在 Google AI Studio 提供，endpoint 未关闭，API 请求自动路由至 Gemini 3.8 Flash。当前 3.8 Flash 的 Standard 活动价至 2026-12-31，之后输入 $1.50、输出 $7.50、缓存读取 $0.15；定价页不再单列 3.7 Flash，本记录保留其历史价格。 核验日期：2026-10-17。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. Standard · promotional rates through 2026. Historical promotional rates: input $0.75, output $3.75, cached $0.075 per million tokens; output includes thinking tokens, and cache storage and search cost extra. The official deprecations page confirms this model is no longer selectable in Google AI Studio, its endpoint is not shutting down, and API requests automatically route to Gemini 3.8 Flash. Current Gemini 3.8 Flash Standard promotional rates run through Dec 31, 2026, then input $1.50, output $7.50 and cached $0.15; the pricing page no longer lists Gemini 3.7 Flash separately, so this record retains its historical price.

item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。输入 $0.3 / 输出 $1.2 / 缓存读取 $0.006（每百万 tokens）。高峰价 · deepseek-flash。非高峰每百万 tokens：输入 $0.15、输出 $0.60、缓存命中 $0.003。高峰为周一至周五北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，中国法定节假日除外；其余时间按非高峰计费。模型名为 deepseek-flash；旧模型名 deepseek-v4-flash、deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 仍可调用，请求由 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 承接并按 Flash 价计费。 当前服务版本为 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，模型调用名及 token 价格不变。Search / Fetch API 单独按成功请求计费，各为 $0.75 / 千次；经 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code 或 Codex 的服务端工具调用目前免费，自北京时间 2026-11-01 00:00 起按请求计费，不换算成 tokens。 核验日期：2026-11-23。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. Peak hours are Monday–Friday, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, excluding Chinese public holidays; all other hours are off-peak. item.title: GLM Coding Plan Lite · —/月
item.description:
计费快照，非实时价格。—/月。2,000 credits / 5 小时 · 10,000 / 周。保留官方 credits 额度，档位完整结算价待核验；credits 不等于 tokens。常规非高峰按半价扣 credits，高峰为周一至周五北京时间 14:00–18:00。2026-09-25 至 10-07 全天半价活动已结束。自 2026-10-16 起，标准模型 API 与 Coding Plan 的 API Key 分开管理：标准密钥在编码工具中也不消耗 Coding Plan 额度、可能按量计费；Coding Plan 密钥按套餐额度计费，切换端点不改变计费类型；存量密钥自动归类，无需替换。 2026-10-25 复核：官方概述页标明套餐“每月 18 美元起”（Starting at just 18 USD per month）并确认各档 credits 与模型路由不变；各档完整结算价在需登录的订阅页展示，仍待核验。 2026-11-17 复核：概述页仍标明“每月 18 美元起”（Starting at just 18 USD per month），各档 credits、模型路由与非高峰半价（高峰为周一至周五 14:00–18:00 UTC+8）不变；各档完整结算价仍在需登录的订阅页展示，保持待核验。 2026-11-21 复核：概述页仍标明“每月 18 美元起”（Starting at just 18 USD per month），官方 API 价格页同称套餐自每月 18 美元起；各档 credits、模型路由与非高峰半价不变。2026-04-21 官方迁移公告列示参考月价 Lite $18 / Pro $72 / Max $160（注明仅供参考）；各档当前结算价仍在需登录的订阅页展示，保持待核验。 核验日期：2026-11-21。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. 2,000 credits / 5 hours · 10,000 / week. Official credit allowances are retained; complete tier checkout prices remain unverified. Credits are not tokens. Off-peak usage consumes half the credits; peak hours are Monday–Friday, 14:00–18:00 UTC+8. The all-day half-credit campaign of September 25–October 7, 2026 has ended. Since October 16, 2026, standard API and Coding Plan keys are managed separately: a Standard key used in coding tools does not consume Coding Plan quota and may incur pay-as-you-go charges; Coding Plan keys bill against plan quota, and switching endpoints does not change the billing type; existing keys are classified automatically and need no replacement. Re-checked on 2026-10-25: the official overview states plans "Starting at just 18 USD per month" and confirms tier credits and model routing unchanged; full per-tier checkout prices remain behind the login-only subscribe page and stay pending. Re-checked on 2026-11-17: the overview still states plans "Starting at just 18 USD per month" and confirms tier credits, model routing and off-peak half-credit billing (peak Monday–Friday 14:00–18:00 UTC+8) unchanged; full per-tier checkout prices remain behind the login-only subscribe page and stay pending. Re-checked on 2026-11-21: the overview still states plans "Starting at just 18 USD per month" and the official API pricing page likewise says plans start at $18 per month; tier credits, model routing and off-peak half-credit billing are unchanged. The official April 21, 2026 migration notice lists reference monthly prices of Lite $18 / Pro $72 / Max $160 (marked for reference only); current per-tier checkout prices remain behind the login-only subscribe page and stay pending. 可用模型 / Supported models: GLM-5.4, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash。所有 GLM Coding Plan 档位均支持 GLM-5.4、GLM-5.3 与 GLM-5.3-Flash。GLM-5.4 在周额度方案中可用额度为 GLM-5.3 的 1.5 倍，标准 credits 消耗为输入 4.6、缓存输入 1.1、输出 16；Model API 尚未开放，需待安全评估完成，不能把 Coding Plan 权益当作 API 价格。GLM-5.2 / 5.1 请求路由至 5.3，GLM-4.7 路由至 Flash。兼容 Claude Code 等工具不代表包含 Claude 模型。 2026-11-23 官方发布博客称 API 即将推出，并计划在完成必要安全加固后开源模型权重；本轮未读到 API 价格或已发布的开源许可。 Every GLM Coding Plan tier supports GLM-5.4, GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash. On weekly-quota plans, GLM-5.4 has 1.5× the available quota of GLM-5.3 and standard credit multipliers of 4.6 input, 1.1 cached input and 16 output. Model API access is pending its security assessment; Coding Plan access is not an API price. GLM-5.2 / 5.1 route to 5.3, and GLM-4.7 routes to Flash. Claude Code tool compatibility does not grant Claude model access. The official November 23, 2026 launch blog says API access is coming soon and model weights are planned to be open-sourced after necessary safety hardening; no API price or published open-source license was established in this verification. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-25。https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.4 https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5.4 https://docs.z.ai/devpack/overview discount / promotion (pending): GLM-5.3-Flash. GLM-5.3-Flash 标准 credits 倍率：输入 2.3、缓存输入 0.56、输出 8；活动倍率：1.15、0.28、4。 GLM-5.3-Flash standard credit multipliers: 2.3 input, 0.56 cached input and 8 output; promotional multipliers: 1.15, 0.28 and 4.
官方页面显示 11 月 24 日至 12 月 24 日期间，GLM-5.3-Flash 的 Coding Plan credits 消耗按标准费率的 50% 结算，即可用额度翻倍。该优惠不改变 Model API 的 Token 价格；活动年份、结束时刻与时区未注明，因此保持待核验。 The official page shows that from November 24 to December 24, GLM-5.3-Flash consumes Coding Plan credits at 50% of the standard rate, effectively doubling available quota. item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。¥49/月。基础 Agent 额度 · 共享会员额度。包含 Kimi Code；与网页、Work、Claw 等共用会员额度。Code 另受每周额度与 5 小时滚动窗口限制，非固定 token 包。 此为旧套餐：档位名称、周限额与续订规则保持原样。新套餐 Plus 及以上才含 Kimi Code，新会员取消周限额；不要混用两套规则。 核验日期：2026-10-11。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. API-key sessions use separate API pricing; actual usage, model allowances, and reset times follow the dashboard. 可用模型 / Supported models: GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna。包含 Codex / Work 订阅模型；GPT-6.1 Sol 与 GPT-6.1 Terra 不适用于 Chat。GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol 与 GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Sol 均可使用 Ultrafast。GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol 的订阅额度消耗为 Standard 的 6 倍，符合条件的购买 credits 在 2027-02-28 前为 3 倍，自 2027-03-01（太平洋时间）起为 6 倍；GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Sol 分别为订阅额度 8 倍、购买 credits 6 倍。先用订阅额度，再扣 credits。Fast 对 GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol 的订阅额度倍率存在官方冲突：Learn 计费表为 2 倍，帮助文档笼统写 2.5 倍；其他列出的 Fast 模型为 2.5 倍，购买 credits 为 2 倍。倍率是额度或费用消耗倍率，不是速度保证。 Includes Codex / Work subscription models; GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6.1 Terra are not available in Chat. GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol and GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Sol support Ultrafast. GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol consume included usage at 6× Standard; eligible purchased-credit overages cost 3× through February 28, 2027 and 6× starting March 1, 2027 (Pacific time). GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Sol use 8× included usage and 6× purchased credits. Included usage is consumed before credits. For GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol, official Fast included-usage multipliers conflict: the Learn pricing table says 2×, while the help article gives a general 2.5× rate. Other listed Fast models use 2.5× included usage, and purchased credits use 2×. Multipliers describe allowance or credit consumption, not speed guarantees. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-25。https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9793128-about-chatgpt-pro-tiers

item.title: Claude Code · Pro · $20/月
item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。$20/月。包含 Claude Code。月付 $20；年付 $200。使用限额适用，API 消耗独立计费。 核验日期：2026-11-23。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. Claude Code included. Monthly $20; annual $200. Usage limits apply; API usage is billed separately. 可用模型 / Supported models: Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Fable 5。官方模型文档：fable 别名在 Claude 应用网关会话解析为 Fable 5，其余环境解析为 Fable 5.2。Fable 5 / 5.1 需额外购买 usage credits，不包含在 Pro 额度内；定价页 FAQ 称 Max 与 Ultra 包含 Fable 至多每周额度一半，Pro 未如此列明。 Haiku 5.5 支持 1M 上下文，超过 100K 提示适用较高 token 费率；额度消耗以套餐面板为准。新版模型需更新 Claude Code 客户端。 Per the official model docs, the fable alias resolves to Fable 5 in Claude apps gateway sessions and to Fable 5.2 everywhere else. Fable 5 / 5.1 require purchased usage credits and are not included in Pro limits; the pricing FAQ says Max and Ultra include Fable for up to half the weekly limit, with no such statement for Pro. Haiku 5.5 supports 1M context, with higher token rates for prompts over 100K; plan usage is determined by the usage dashboard. Update Claude Code for newer models. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-23。https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15424964-claude-fable-models-on-your-plan https://claude.com/pricing

item.title: Claude Code · Max · $100/月
item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。$100/月。5× Pro 用量（每 5 小时与每周）。月付 $100。每 5 小时与每周 5× Pro 用量；含每月 $100 Claude Platform API credits（新增权益），Fable 包含在额度内至多每周额度一半。原 20× 用量档已由新的 Ultra 档取代。API credits 资格与使用规则以官方条款为准，不换算为固定 tokens。 核验日期：2026-11-23。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. 5× Pro usage per 5 hours and weekly. The former 20× usage tier is replaced by the new Ultra tier. API credit eligibility and usage follow official terms, without conversion into a fixed token allowance. 可用模型 / Supported models: Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Fable 5。Fable 5 / 5.1 / 5.2 最多使用每周额度的 50%（定价页 FAQ：Max 与 Ultra 包含 Fable 至多每周额度一半）；达到上限后需额外 credits 或切换模型。官方模型文档：fable 别名在 Claude 应用网关会话解析为 Fable 5，其余环境解析为 Fable 5.2。 Haiku 5.5 支持 1M 上下文，超过 100K 提示适用较高 token 费率；额度消耗以套餐面板为准。新版模型需更新客户端。 Fable 5 / 5.1 / 5.2 can use up to 50% of weekly limits (pricing FAQ: Max and Ultra include Fable for up to half the weekly limit); then use purchased credits or switch models. Per the official model docs, the fable alias resolves to Fable 5 in Claude apps gateway sessions and to Fable 5.2 everywhere else. Haiku 5.5 supports 1M context, with higher token rates for prompts over 100K; plan usage is determined by the usage dashboard. Newer models require an updated client. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-23。https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15424964-claude-fable-models-on-your-plan https://claude.com/pricing

item.title: Cursor Pro (legacy) · $20/月
item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。$20/月。Agent + Cloud Agents。含 Cursor Models 与 Other Models 两个用量池；第三方模型按 API 费率扣用量，超额可选按量付费。 此为旧订阅，已停止新购；已有订阅可保留现有价格及权益，包括第三方模型用量池。迁移至 The X Subscription 后改用新套餐规则，迁移入口依账号逐步开放。 核验日期：2026-11-24。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. Agent + Cloud Agents. Includes Cursor Models and Other Models pools; third-party usage is charged at API rates, with optional on-demand billing after limits. Legacy subscription, closed to new sign-ups. Existing subscribers can keep current prices and benefits, including the third-party model pool. Switching to The X Subscription adopts new-tier rules as account migration rolls out. 可用模型 / Supported models: Composer 2.5, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, Grok 4.7, Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, Muse Wonder, Gemini 4 Argon, Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Neon。列出当前官方模型目录；Cursor 自有模型与第三方模型分用量池扣费，用量并非无限。团队可用性还受管理员策略限制。 Haiku 5.5 已列入官方目录；第三方模型费率与直连 API 可能不同，以 Cursor 表为准。 当前目录加入 Gemini 4 Argon；原订阅继续使用两个按月重置的用量池。 当前模型目录以 Muse Wonder 取代 Muse Spark 1.3；当前目录新增 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Gemini 4 Carbon / Hydrogen / Neon；它们属于可选第三方目录，不进入订阅内含的 Grok / Composer 周池。Cursor 表列 GPT-5.6 Sol 每百万 tokens 输入 $4、缓存写入 $5、缓存读取 $0.40、输出 $20；Cursor 仍标注促销至 2026-11-21，OpenAI 官方页则标至 2026-11-30。本轮以 $4/$20 为当前价，11 月 30 日后 Cursor 专属费率未核实。OpenAI 已临时延长 Cursor 访问，旧 11 月 12 日日期不是终止日，最终终止日尚未公布。 Current official model catalog. Cursor and third-party models draw from separate usage pools; usage is limited. Team access also follows admin policies. Haiku 5.5 is in the official catalog; third-party model rates can differ from direct API rates, so use the Cursor pricing table. The current catalog adds Gemini 4 Argon; legacy subscriptions retain two monthly usage pools. The current catalog replaces Muse Spark 1.3 with Muse Wonder. The current catalog adds Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon as selectable third-party models; they are outside the included Grok/Composer weekly pool. Cursor lists GPT-5.6 Sol at $4 input, $5 cache writes, $0.40 cache reads and $20 output per million tokens. Cursor still labels the promotion through 2026-11-21, while OpenAI lists it through 2026-11-30. The current $4/$20 rate is supported; the Cursor-specific rate after November 30 is unverified. OpenAI has temporarily extended Cursor access, so the old November 12 date is not a termination date, and no final termination date is published. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-24。https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing https://x.ai/news/x-subscription https://cursor.com/docs/account/pricing/legacy-cursor-plans https://openai.com/index/our-decision-on-cursor-following-its-acquisition-by-spacex/ https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001506-using-openai-models-in-cursor https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing

item.title: OpenCode Open source / BYOK · $0 · 无订阅费 / No subscription fee
item.description:
计费快照，非实时价格。$0 · 无订阅费 / No subscription fee。客户端免费；自带 Key、已有订阅或免费模型。Go 订阅可选，Zen 按量付费；第三方 API 或已有订阅按原厂商规则计费。 核验日期：2026-11-23。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. Free client; own keys, existing subscriptions or free models. Go is optional; Zen bills by usage. External APIs and existing subscriptions follow provider terms. 可用模型 / Supported models: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Ollama / local models。客户端免费；Console（原 Zen）按量计费，免费端点为限时提供，当前免费表列出 11 个端点：Big Pickle、Tidepool Alpha Free、Iceman Free、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free、Beam Free、Flint 40B Free、Hy4 flash Free、MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free、Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free、Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free、Jev 1.13 Free。 Big Pickle、Tidepool Alpha Free、Iceman Free 与 Flint 40B Free 为隐身（stealth）模型；Big Pickle、Tidepool Alpha Free 与 Iceman Free 免费期数据可能留存并用于改进模型，Flint 40B Free 数据留存 30 天。 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free 与 Hy4 flash Free 供应商零留存、不用于训练。Beam Free 不用于训练、安全留存 30 天，并受官方列出的地区限制（含中国内地、香港、澳门）。 两个 Nemotron 免费端点为 NVIDIA 试用条款，会记录使用用于安全与产品改进，不应提交个人或机密数据。 本轮免费表移除 GLM-5.3-Flash Free、LongCat 2.5 Preview Free、Exo Free、MiMo-V2.5 Free 与 Nemotron 3 Ultra Free；不以名称更替推断身份继承。 The client is free; the Console (formerly Zen) bills by usage, and free endpoints are temporary. The current free table lists 11 endpoints: Big Pickle, Tidepool Alpha Free, Iceman Free, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free, Beam Free, Flint 40B Free, Hy4 flash Free, MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free and Jev 1.13 Free. Big Pickle, Tidepool Alpha Free, Iceman Free and Flint 40B Free are stealth models; during the free period, data from Big Pickle, Tidepool Alpha Free and Iceman Free may be retained and used to improve the models, and Flint 40B Free retains it for 30 days. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free and Hy4 flash Free follow provider zero-retention policies with no training. Beam Free excludes training and retains data for safety for 30 days, with regional restrictions including mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau. The two Nemotron free endpoints follow NVIDIA trial terms with security and product-improvement logging; do not submit personal or confidential data. This round the free table drops GLM-5.3-Flash Free, LongCat 2.5 Preview Free, Exo Free, MiMo-V2.5 Free and Nemotron 3 Ultra Free; naming changes alone do not establish identity or succession. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-23。https://opencode.ai/docs/providers/ https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/models/ free / limited-time (verified): Big Pickle, Tidepool Alpha Free, Iceman Free, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free, Beam Free, Flint 40B Free, Hy4 flash Free, MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free, Jev 1.13 Free. 11 个限时免费端点；官方未给出统一请求额度，实际限制以服务为准 11 temporarily free endpoints; no common request quota is published, and service limits apply

item.description: 计费快照，非实时价格。$10/月。各模型月额度 $15–$200；限额按 5 小时、每周与月度窗口计算。各模型有独立的美元用量上限，按 5 小时、每周与月度窗口分别计算（官方请求量为估算，各模型比例不同）。可从 Console 购买 credit 并开启 Extra Usage，超过 Go 限额后请求改用余额计费。Go / Go Plus 覆盖订阅成员本人及 workspace 的 API key；被邀请的其他成员使用免费模型或 workspace 余额，可随时升级 Go Teams，升级时未用满的月度额度折算 credit。直接 API 端点按协议区分为 /inference/go/openai/v1、/inference/go/anthropic/v1 与 /inference/go/google/v1beta。当前各模型月度美元上限：Go $15–$200（GLM-5.3 为 $200，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 为 $100）；Go Plus $60–$400（GLM-5.3 为 $400）。 核验日期：2026-11-23。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. Per-model monthly allowances $15–$200; limits counted over 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows. Each model has its own dollar-denominated allowance counted over 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows (published request counts are estimates and ratios vary by model). Buy credit in the Console and turn on Extra Usage so requests beyond Go limits bill against the balance. Go / Go Plus cover the subscribing member and the workspace's API keys; invited members use free models or the workspace balance and can upgrade to Go Teams any time, with the unused part of the month's allowance credited.Direct API endpoints vary by protocol: /inference/go/openai/v1, /inference/go/anthropic/v1 and /inference/go/google/v1beta. Current monthly dollar limits: Go $15–$200 (GLM-5.3 at $200, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at $100); Go Plus $60–$400 (GLM-5.3 at $400). 可用模型 / Supported models: Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, Qwen3.8 Max, Grok 4.7, Step 5 Preview, Qwen4 Max, Gemini 4 Argon, GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.7 Code, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Hy4 preview, GPT-5.6 Luna, GLM-5.3, Hy4, MiniMax-M3, MiMo-V2.6-Pro, Claude Haiku 5.5, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, GPT-6 Luna, Hy3, Qwen3.7 Plus, Qwen3.8 Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, LongCat 2.5, MiMo-V2.6-Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor, Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor, Beam Free, Hy4 flash Free, Iceman Contributor Free。官方模型表共 31 个模型，两档覆盖同一表但逐模型额度不同。本轮变化：新增 Kimi K3.1 Pro、Qwen4 Max、Hy4、Hy4 flash Free 与 Iceman Contributor Free；MiMo-V2.5、MiMo-V2.5-Pro、LongCat-2.0 与 LongCat 2.5 Preview Free 不再列出，新表改列 LongCat 2.5；官方写法变化：GPT 6 Luna / GPT 5.6 Luna / MiniMax M3 / Gemini 4 Argon Contributor / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 分别显示为 GPT-6 Luna / GPT-5.6 Luna / MiniMax-M3 / Gemini 4 Argon / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017；不以名称更替推断身份继承。 Console 弃用表列 LongCat-2.0 弃用日 2026-11-22、GLM 5.2 为 2026-11-19，而 Go 模型表当日仍列 GLM-5.2，以官方端点可用性为准。 Beam Free 限时免费、不用于训练，安全留存 30 天，受官方列出的地区限制（含中国内地、香港、澳门）；Hy4 flash Free 为限时免费端点。Muse Spark Contributor 端点受地域限制且可能用请求改进模型。 The official model table lists 31 models; both tiers cover the same table with different per-model allowances. Changes this round: Kimi K3.1 Pro, Qwen4 Max, Hy4, Hy4 flash Free and Iceman Contributor Free were added; MiMo-V2.5, MiMo-V2.5-Pro, LongCat-2.0 and LongCat 2.5 Preview Free are no longer listed, and the table now shows LongCat 2.5; official labels changed: GPT 6 Luna / GPT 5.6 Luna / MiniMax M3 / Gemini 4 Argon Contributor / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash now display as GPT-6 Luna / GPT-5.6 Luna / MiniMax-M3 / Gemini 4 Argon / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017; naming changes alone do not establish identity or succession. The Console deprecation table lists LongCat-2.0 deprecated on 2026-11-22 and GLM 5.2 on 2026-11-19, while the Go model table still lists GLM-5.2 that day; official endpoint availability prevails. Beam Free is temporarily free, excludes training and retains data for safety for 30 days, with regional restrictions including mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau; Hy4 flash Free is a limited-time free endpoint. Muse Spark Contributor endpoints have regional restrictions and may use requests to improve their models. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-23。https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go/ https://opencode.ai/console/go#models

item.title: Kiro Pro · $20/席位/月
item.description:
计费快照，非实时价格。$20/席位/月。1,000 credits / 月；IDE 与 CLI 共用。月额度不结转；个人社交登录 / AWS Builder ID 可购买追加 credits，$0.04/个，未用完可结转并在购买后 12 个月过期。企业超额用量须管理员启用，按 $0.04/个月底结算。展示商业区域税前价。 核验日期：2026-11-24。 Pricing snapshot, not a live quote. 1,000 credits/month shared across IDE and CLI. Monthly included credits do not roll over. Individual social-login / AWS Builder ID users can buy add-on credits at $0.04 each; unused add-ons roll over and expire 12 months after purchase. Enterprise overages require administrator enablement and are billed at $0.04 per credit at month-end. Commercial-region prices are before tax. 可用模型 / Supported models: GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, Auto, Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek 3.2, MiniMax M2.5, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1, Qwen3 Coder Next, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3。按模型表收录；不同模型扣费倍率不同，可用性受地域限制，Fable 5.1 仅企业可用，不在个人档位中。 GPT-5.6 请求超过 272K tokens 后扣费倍率翻倍：Sol 8.8×、Terra 4.4×、Luna 1.2×；个人订阅使用 US 推理端点。 官方 10 月 14 日生命周期公告明确 Sonnet 4 已退役；模型总表仍保留旧行，本目录按退役公告移除，Sonnet 4.5 与其不同。 Kimi K3 为实验支持，1M 上下文、文本与图像输入、2.4× credits，仅 Pro / Pro+ / Pro Max / Power 的 US geography；10 月 15 日的模型公告称使用 US geography 内跨区域推理；本轮模型总表已可读取：US East (N. Virginia) 配置列为 US，Europe (Frankfurt) 列为不可用；地域条件按公告与模型表分别保留。IDE / CLI 需重启、Crew 需 kirocrew restart、Web 需刷新。 10 月 21 日 Sonnet 5.5、GPT-5.6 Terra / Luna 已转正式可用；Fable 5.1 同步在 us-east-1 的企业方案正式可用。GPT-5.6 Sol 仍属实验模型。US 推理端点不代表请求留在美国：GPT-5.6 表列 Global，可跨全球受支持商业区域处理；存储地域与推理路由分别约束。 Claude Haiku 5.5 支持 1M 上下文，100K 以内为 0.06× credits，超过 100K 为 0.3×。 Grok 4.7 为实验模型，500K 上下文，200K 以内 2.7×、超过 200K 5.4× credits，仅 US geography。Claude Fable 5.1 为企业正式可用、Fable 5.2 为企业预览，均需模型治理，不适用于个人档。 Model table access; multipliers and regional restrictions apply. Enterprise-only Fable 5.1 is excluded from these individual tiers. GPT-5.6 requests over 272K tokens double the credit multiplier: Sol 8.8×, Terra 4.4× and Luna 1.2×; individual subscribers use the US inference endpoint. The October 14 lifecycle notice retires Sonnet 4. The overview table still has its old row; this catalog follows the retirement notice and removes it. Sonnet 4.5 is distinct. Kimi K3 has experimental support with 1M context, text/image input and a 2.4× credit multiplier, limited to Pro / Pro+ / Pro Max / Power in the US geography. The October 15 model announcement describes cross-region inference within the US geography. The model overview is readable in this check: its US East (N. Virginia) profile lists US, while Europe (Frankfurt) is unavailable. Regional conditions from the announcement and table are retained separately. Restart IDE / CLI, run kirocrew restart for Crew, or refresh Web. Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Terra / Luna became generally available on October 21; Fable 5.1 became GA for Enterprise in us-east-1. GPT-5.6 Sol remains experimental. A US inference endpoint does not restrict processing to the US: GPT-5.6 is listed as Global and may process across supported commercial regions worldwide. Storage location and inference routing are separate. Claude Haiku 5.5 supports 1M context at 0.06× credits through 100K and 0.3× above 100K. Grok 4.7 is experimental with 500K context, 2.7× credits through 200K and 5.4× above 200K, limited to the US geography. Claude Fable 5.1 is Enterprise GA and Fable 5.2 is an Enterprise preview; both require model governance and are unavailable on individual plans. 模型权益核验 / Model access checked: 2026-11-24。https://kiro.dev/docs/models/ https://kiro.dev/changelog/models/claude-sonnet-4-end-of-life https://kiro.dev/changelog/models/kimi-k3-now-available-in-kiro free / trial (verified): GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, Auto, Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek 3.2, MiniMax M2.5, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1, Qwen3 Coder Next, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3. 首次升级当月剩余天数免费（费用与 credits 按秒折算），另赠 500 试用 credits，须在 12 个月内使用；试用 credits 在套餐 credits 用完后消耗。 The rest of the first upgrade month is free (fees and credits prorated to the second), plus 500 trial credits usable within 12 months; trial credits are consumed after plan credits run out.
仅适用于从 Kiro Free 首次升级到付费方案：首张账单于次月 1 日出具。直接选择 Pro+ / Pro Max / Power 时免费 Pro 月仍计入，只付所选方案按秒折算价与 Pro 折算价的差额。再次升级按常规折算，无免费月；退回免费档后未用完的试用 credits 保留，但只能用于免费档模型。官方说明 11 月 1 日前升级的用户保留 $20 折扣与未用完 credits。 Applies only to the first upgrade from Kiro Free to a paid plan; the first bill arrives on the 1st of the following month. Starting directly on Pro+ / Pro Max / Power still counts the free Pro month: you pay only the difference between your plan’s prorated price and the prorated Pro price. Later upgrades are prorated as usual without a free month. Returning to Free keeps unused trial credits, usable only on free-tier models. Per the official page, users who upgraded before November 1 keep the $20 discount and their unused credits. 资格 / Eligibility: 首次从 Kiro Free 升级到付费方案的用户；升级须绑定有效信用卡，并非无条件免费使用。 / Users upgrading from Kiro Free to a paid plan for the first time; a valid credit card is required, so this is not unconditional free usage..
